Name: ChestItemFinder
Author: cynthiazhao0411
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
ChestItemFinder helps you find which chest holds the item you're looking for. Press a key to open a search box, and matching chests pulse in the world. An on-screen message tells you how many chests were found and in which locations. Built for late-game farms where you have too many chests to remember what's in each one.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI (https://smapi.io).
2. Download the zip and extract the ChestItemFinder folder into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.
4. Load a save and press LeftShift + T to open the search box. Type the item name and press Enter.
*(You can change the search key in `config.json` or in-game if you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed.)*

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Searches every storage everywhere: all chests (incl. Junimo chests and mini-fridges), the farmhouse / cabin / island fridges, Auto-Grabbers, the Mill's output bin, Junimo Huts and dressers, in every building and on Ginger Island.[/*]
[*]Press LeftShift + T to open a clean in-game search box instead of typing console commands.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Nearest First: Places are sorted by real walking distance. Ginger Island areas use the parrot-express names (Docks, Farm, Dig Site, Jungle).[/*]
[*]Visual Edge Routing: If the nearest target is off-screen, a red arrow at the screen edge guides you, even across different maps.[/*]
[*]Clear Labels: The panel and arrows say what each container is ("2 fridges", "Auto-Grabber: Barn", "Farmhouse (fridge)").[/*]
[*]Quality Rows: Searching one item lists each quality on its own row with its star (plain, silver, gold, iridium).[/*]
[*]Interactive Empty States: If nothing is found in chests, a "Check Backpack" button appears (only if the item is in your inventory).[/*]
[*]Keep Highlights Feature: Check the box in the result panel to keep chests highlighted. Hover over it to bring the result panel back, with all its tooltips.[/*]
[*]Smart Auto-Suggest: Real-time suggestions with correct item icons, for every storable item, including generated items like Peach Wine and clothing.[/*]
[*]Helpful Hints: Names that don't exist (e.g. "corn jelly") explain what the item really becomes ("Corn becomes Pickled Corn in a Preserves Jar."), with options to click.[/*]
[*]Common Names: "dried grape" finds Raisins, "honey wine" finds Mead, "aged sturgeon roe" finds Caviar, and more. Singular or plural never matters.[/*]
[*]Recent Searches: Quick access to your search history, with a one-click clear button and pinning feature. History remembers your exact quality filter.[/*]
[*]Multi-term Search: Search up to 3 things at once using commas, spaces, semicolons, or slashes (e.g., fruit, fish).[/*]
[*]Advanced Smart Matching: Categories (e.g., fruit), ingredient categories (e.g., fruit wine, fish roe), exact matches (e.g., star fruit), family names (e.g., shirt), fuzzy fallback (e.g., star), and spelling correction (Did you mean).[/*]
[*]Quality Filter System: Cycle quality (Any, Silver, Gold, Iridium, No Quality) or type "gold star apple" directly. Items without quality ignore this filter.[/*]
[*]Full Text Editing: The search box supports Ctrl+A/C/X/V, mouse drag selection, double-click, and triple-click to select all. Right-click for Copy/Paste.[/*]
[*]Controller Support: A on "Keep highlights" or the red X of the result panel, B closes the search box.[/*]
[*]Smart UI Flipping: The result panel and Keep Highlights box automatically flip to the top or bottom depending on your toolbar position.[/*]
[*]Hover Tooltip & Pause: Hover over a place to see item counts. Hovering over the UI pauses the highlight countdown.[/*]
[*]Highlights automatically clear after opening a target chest or when the timer runs out.[/*]
[*]Fully customizable via GMCM: 10 colors, opacity slider, timeout settings, custom keybind, and a reset button.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI 4.0 or later
- Generic Mod Config Menu (Optional, to change the default H keybind in-game)
